title: Export the whole audit log, page by page

blocks.text: Compliance archives every tenant's audit log once a month. The audit service hands a log out in pages: `fetch(null)` returns the first page, and each page carries the cursor that fetches the page after it, or `null` on the last one. A page can come back empty while the service moves a tenant between partitions, and still carry a cursor.
Last month's archive files were empty for every tenant, and nobody noticed for three weeks.
Write `exportAll()` in `src/main/java/practice/AuditExport.java`: every event of the log, in the order the service returns them, whatever the number of pages. About six lines.

cases.says: a log with no events exports nothing
the first page is fetched before anything tells the export whether there is one, so a one-page log is exported
the page fetched to start the walk is exported too, not only the pages after it
the export ends when there is no cursor, not when a page comes back empty

origin.section: A do-while Fits a Loop Whose First Pass Produces What the Condition Tests

concepts: A do-while makes its first pass before the test, so it fits a loop whose condition reads what a pass produces, such as a page cursor; a while loop there may never run.
